sections.h2: Campus East Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 99 residential sales closed in Campus East (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $250,000, below the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 9 days to sell, faster than the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Campus East sales closed between $232,674 and $265,000, or about $177 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($262,500, 32 sales) was about 6% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($248,000, 67 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Campus East sales were in ZIP code 23462.

sections.h2: When Campus East Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Campus East
sections.html:
All of the sales were attached homes such as townhomes or condos. The median home was about 1,440 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,348 to 1,568 square feet. 83% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1983 and 1985, with a median year built of 1984, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.
